candidate_contract.signature: void add_16_llm(data_t lhs[16], data_t rhs[16], data_t output[16])
candidate_contract.operation: For each i, compute output[i] = lhs[i] + rhs[i].

testbench.input_rule: Use deterministic small fixed-point values for lhs and rhs.
testbench.golden_rule: Compute lhs[i] + rhs[i] in the testbench with tolerance 0.001.

demo.description: LLM candidate version of the Add fallback demo.
